ideas.title: Investigating Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent Medicaid freeze in Minnesota and the potential for fraud and abuse.
questions: What is the extent of the Medicaid freeze in Minnesota?
How much money is at risk of being lost to fraud and abuse?
ideas.insight: The Medicaid freeze in Minnesota raises concerns about the potential for fraud and abuse. By analyzing data and following the money, we can identify potential red flags and determine the extent of the problem.

ideas.title: Education Fraud: A Growing Concern
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent investigation into LAUSD Superintendent Alberto Carvalho and the broader issue of education fraud.
questions: What are the allegations against LAUSD Superintendent Alberto Carvalho?
How common is education fraud in the United States?
ideas.insight: The investigation into LAUSD Superintendent Alberto Carvalho highlights the need for increased oversight and accountability in education. By analyzing public records and speaking with whistleblowers, we can identify potential red flags and determine the extent of the problem.
